senses.gloss: (b. h.; Pilp. of חלל)to penetrate into cavities; to perforate.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 7b">Sot. 7ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:33">Num. R. s. 9</cite> <he>מְחַלְחֵל ויורד</he> (the powder on a wound) penetrates and goes down (into the body).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98:14">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> <he>ריסו מח׳ וכ׳</he> its venom penetrates (the body of the bitten one) after (the serpent’s) death.

Makhsh. III, 6 ח׳ לתוכן if he washed olives by rolling them in the rain water.—Part. pass. מְחוּלְחָל, f. מְחוּלְחֶלֶת hollow, blown up; loosely put in. Oh. IX, 7 כלי מח׳ a hollow vessel (not packed entirely), opp. אֲפוּצָה.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 10:3">Kel. X, 3</cite> <he>מגופת החבית המח׳ וכ׳</he> (Bart. <he>המִתְחַלְחֶ׳</he>) the stopper of a keg which can be moved around, without, however, falling out of itself. Teb. Yom I, 1; a. fr.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:23">Num. R. s. 9</cite> <he>שהם מִתְחַלְחֲלִים וכ׳</he> that they will permeate all her limbs.

senses.gloss: to be shaken in a hollow space, to be thrown about.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 4:3">Mikv. IV, 3</cite> <he>היו צרורות מתח׳ וכ׳</he> if pebbles rolled about in the spout.

senses.gloss: to be permeated (with poison) to be affected, injured. Y. B. Kam. I, beg. 2ᵇ ונתח׳ כולו and the whole of it is damaged (by the heat &c.).
(cmp. חָלָה) to be weakened, be neutralized. Y. Ter. VIII, 46ᵃ top ע״י מליחה מתח׳ through salting it, the poison is neutralized.
